concealed_flags.rule_text: Water staining that reaches within 0.15 m of the floor implies moisture has tracked down behind the wall finish into the floor junction. The subfloor and the wall cavity below the visible stain are likely wet even though nothing is visible there.
concealed_flags.recommended_action: Moisture-meter the lower 0.6 m of the wall and the floor within 1 m of it. Lift a floor covering sample at the wall junction if readings exceed 18% WME.

concealed_flags.rule_text: A crack longer than 1.0 m that reaches the floor junction is unlikely to be shrinkage alone. Movement of that length usually continues behind the finish and into the substrate.
concealed_flags.recommended_action: Expose the crack ends, check for displacement across it, and re-inspect after 4 weeks to establish whether it is live.
